text.description_html:
Acorn APZBP, Smooth Iron Old World Exterior Ring Pull

This decorative Old World Ring Pull is finished for exterior use on shutters, small utility doors, as a decoration, or anywhere that a pull would look good. It is easy to install with the four included screws. Acorn's Ring Pull is typical of Early American styling, with a matte black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged. It is also typical of early European and Colonial American styles, anywhere hand made forged home hardware was used.

Specifications for the Acorn APZBP Ring Pull:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Plate Width: 2"
  • Plate Height: 1-7/16"
  • Ring Steel Thickness: 1/4"
  • Plate Material Cast Zinc Aluminum

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application. This door pull is handmade and all dimensions are approximate.
